asof: At each T15 decision use only bars completed by T15 and financial/industry/factor/risk information available by then; execute at a separately declared later time. No execution price or future membership enters the forecast.
control_market_context: Registered attention and FiLM modules are inactive in control forward. Market six-vector is not an active input; industry embedding is active.

feature_normalization.factor_only_replacement: columns40:104 sqrt(12)*((average_tied_rank-0.5)/n-0.5), each factor own finite historical member cohort before window screening; n<2 NaN; no rank by label/complete-window cohort
feature_normalization.missing: All original finite/missing flags preserved; model internally replaces nonfinite continuous values by zero plus missing indicators.
feature_normalization.native122: Assembled source fields after current historical member 1/99 percentile clipping, population z-score and +/-5 cap. Do not feed unprocessed bars or refit using later dates.
feature_normalization.slow_fields: Daily/financial/factor fields retain original availability lags and are replicated into four same-day slots; source provenance must precede signal.

forward_eligibility: Current historical member AND all preceding80 hour_complete flags. Not future member status or finite labels. Original minimum100 forward stocks.

industry.availability: latest weekly snapshot strictly before signal calendar date; unseen codes -> 0
industry.taxonomy_limit: historical provider S-codes; not externally certified stable SW taxonomy

limitations: This is a retrospective T2025 recipe trained during2026, not a model deployed in2025.
2019-2023 training and2024 validation; fixed selected best checkpoints carried into2025 and2026. It is not annually retrained walk-forward inference.
Historical2025/2026 tests and portfolio returns already exposed; sharing or replay is not fresh OOS.
Feature names plus weights do not reconstruct all factor expressions, PIT data or native122 normalization. Exact new predictions require the original input semantics and aligned exposures.
Original panel whole-day-quality latent causal limitation remains inherited; not live or end-to-end certification.
model_family: OLD_RANK control 122 inputs; not R/rank_label3 and not minute134

processed_score.missing: Missing stock scores stay NaN. Portfolio helper maps missing signal to neutral multiplier while retaining PCF basket; do not drop from basket.
processed_score.recipe: Per-seed head4 population-z, plain 5-seed mean, current-member four-style OLS residual, EMA0.2, final current-member population-z.
processed_score.state: EMA stores pre-final-z row. Run full2024 warmup before2025; do not reset at2026 or substitute last exported z-score for EMA state.
processed_score.style_details: First two exposure columns average-tie percentile-ranked; all four standardized on finite score+all-style cohort; OLS includes intercept and requires100 stocks.

raw_output: float32[5,N,4] in explicit seed66,77,88,99,111 order. Index3 is y4 raw head, not an expected return and not the processed score.

window.hidden_state: new zero state for each independent 80-hour window
